dedupe_keys.name: world bank infrastructure indicators by country world development indicators via hdx

description: The World Bank publishes country datasets of infrastructure indicators from its data portal on the Humanitarian Data Exchange, one per country, with a consolidated combined-indicators dataset alongside. According to the World Bank, the indicators reflect investment in water, sanitation, energy, housing, transport and information and communication technologies, and are compiled from sources such as the International Road Federation, Containerisation International, the International Civil Aviation Organization, the IEA and the International Telecommunication Union. Each country dataset covers 1960 to 2025 as a downloadable CSV file under CC BY, updated yearly; the cross-cutting harvest queued the Nigeria, Pakistan, India, Philippines, Greenland, Algeria, Germany and Ethiopia datasets. Caveats: indicators are national aggregates, definitions and sources vary by indicator, and the HDX copies mirror the World Bank portal, not adding data. They provide national context for capacity planning and resilience comparisons across infrastructure sectors and for scenario baselines in climate adaptation studies; a related record is the World Bank Private Participation in Infrastructure database.
name: World Bank infrastructure indicators by country (World Development Indicators via HDX)
notes: One record covers the eight country datasets queued from HDX.
